results.content:
Favorability polling is different. It focuses on how voters feel about the person in general.

Civiqs' national favorability data shows 58% of voters have a negative outlook on the president. About 38% of people viewed him favorably as of Aug. 31. Mississippi polling has the same results.

YouGov's poll for The Economist says Trump stands at 58% unfavorable, 39.6% favorable, and 2.4% don't know as of Aug. 10. [...] Nationally, Trump's approval rating of 33% is also lower than former President Joe Biden’s lowest approval rating of 35% in October 2024, according to Reuters/Ipsos tracking.

Mississippi, however, still likes Trump more than Biden.
